---
title: Quick Start
description: Initialize Beads, create work, add dependencies, and find ready tasks
---
Initialize with `bd init`, create issues, connect work with dependencies, and query `bd ready` to find claimable tasks. The quick start introduces the common workflow but leaves detailed dependency and synchronization semantics to the dedicated guides. See [Dependencies](/core-concepts/dependencies), [Ready](/cli-reference/ready), and [Sync Setup](/getting-started/sync-setup).
